  • Constructor Details

    • Detection

      public Detection(Pose pose, double tx, double ty, double confidence, double area, int classId)
      Parameters:
      pose - where the element sits on the field (inches)
      tx - horizontal angle from the camera crosshair to the element, in degrees (positive is right)
      ty - vertical angle from the camera crosshair to the element, in degrees (positive is up)
      confidence - detector confidence, from 0 to 1
      area - how much of the image the element fills, as reported by the camera
      classId - the detector's class id
